title: IncomeDeclaration
description: Body of POST /v1/memory/proposals/{proposal_id}/confirm (from the copilot's card) and of PUT /v1/profile/income (from Perfil): the salary the user confirms, as they selected or typed it. User-only HTTP flows; the owner comes from authentication, never from the body. `base`, the previous salary and its pay month, is stored with the change in one atomic write when the chain has no version yet; it must start before the change. Neither is born verified. `expected_version` is compare-and-swap on the chain (409 VERSION_CONFLICT). The answer is memory_view.

session_id.description: Card confirmations only: the chat session, for the origin reference.
